title: Delete Node in a Linked List
problemStatement: You are given a reference to a node in a singly linked list. The given node is not the last node of the list. Delete the given node from the linked list without access to the head of the list.
input: A reference to the node to be deleted.
output: The modified linked list after deletion.
constraints: The given node is guaranteed not to be the last node. Number of nodes is in the range [2, 1000].
